notes.title: Patch Notes July
notes.notes: [p]Hello Fellow Harvesters![/p][p][/p][p]As we introduce different ways of gaining APS we noticed the apple bonus is being overshadowed by the new mechanics. To keep the rarity of apples relevant and valuable we decided to add an additional bonus to having higher tier apples.[/p][p][/p][p]Different rarities of apples will provide aps bonus when equipped. [/p][p]mythic 5% [/p][p]legendary 4% [/p][p]epic 3% [/p][p]rare 2% [/p][p]uncommon 1% [/p][p][/p][p]Additionally The number units are reworked for ease of readability - K, M and B representing thousands millions and billions. [/p][p][/p][p]The window screen size will now remember your last setting upon opening the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your ongoing support and input helping us grow.[/p][p]Goodluck Harvesters! [/p]

notes.title: Bugs are invading
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][/p][p]We have implemented an APS Yield of 2x per each interval. [/p][p][/p][p]HandPicker interval = 40lvl[/p][p]Fertilizer interval = 20lvl[/p][p]HoneyBees interval = 15lvl[/p][p]Plantation interval = 10lvl [/p][p]GreenHouse interval = 5lvl[/p][p][/p][p]At lvl 37 There will be a new game mechanic where 1-8 Caterpillars will spawn every 20mins, ranging from small medium and large. If left to ravage your apples the penalty will be -1, -2, or -3% APS respectively. These bugs will also yield one hour worth of APS based on the penalty percentage. [/p][p]For example the medium one will take off 2 percent of your passive yield but destroying it will give you 2 percent of an hour of your APS instantly. leaving them unattended will slow your progression overall and if you destroy them within the hour you will regain all your losses and then some. [/p][p][/p][p]  Happy Harvest Everyone![/p]

notes.title: Big update!✨
notes.notes:
Update Note✨🍎🍏

Removed autoclicker - which has been replaced by abilities that can be bought with clickable apples.
Each upgrade of these abilities increases yield by a set amount per level per second.
Handpicker 0.1 APS initial cost 1000 cost multiplier 1.05
Fertilizer 0.5 APS initial cost 5000 cost multiplier 1.15
Honeybees 2 APS initial cost 15000 cost multiplier 1.25
Plantation 10 APS initial cost 50000 cost multiplier 1.35
Greenhouse 50 APS initial cost 150000 cost multiplier 1.45

Introduced offline idle income which is 10% of overall ingame APS.

Added random speech boxes that apples will say to the player as you play.
Having a better apple equipped increases rep with the apples which alter what it chooses to say to you.
Starting from outright disrespectful to honored of your presence. 

Added an idle animation for the apple on screen when player is not actively clicking.

The gift box price will increase sharply to match with the ever growing  yield
price increments increases every 12 purchases so plan your spending accordingly.

Happy harvesting yall🌿

notes.title: Gift box price increase update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We noticed that spending wasn't quite keeping up with your apple yield, so we've made some adjustments to the gift box pricing system 🍎🎁

From now on, the box price will increase in steps of 100, 250, 500, and 1000, and it will cap at 100,000 until the next season update.

Happy harvesting, and enjoy the game! 🌿✨

notes.title: Hotfix: Crash After 1-Hour Runtime
notes.notes:
Memory Leak / Orphan Nodes
Added explicit cleanup of spawned apple nodes and their child resources to eliminate orphaned Area2D, Sprite2D, AnimationPlayer, and AudioStreamPlayer2D instances.

Save-Thread Stability
Ensured the background save thread runs at LOW priority and joins before spawning new saves, preventing CPU contention.

Thanks for your patience!🧡🍎🍏
This should eliminate the silent crash around the 1 hour mark and keep your session running smoothly!
